name: Fantasy School
source:
You play as a guy who just came out of a coma. You meet a succubus named Lilly who will help you through the story. You will learn about your mother's side of your family. There are a lot of secrets about your background that are being kept from you. Learn what they are and meet lots of girls. And with a succubus with you, this story can only steer you to a big harem. Enjoy and hope you like this developing story.

[From [url=https://darklender-studios.itch.io/fantasy-school]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名刚刚从昏迷中苏醒的青年，并邂逅一位名叫莉莉的魅魔，由她一路伴你推进故事。你将逐步了解母亲那一脉的家族往事——你的身世背后隐藏着诸多一直向你隐瞒的秘密。揭开这些谜团，邂逅众多性格各异的美少女吧。既然身边有魅魔相伴，这段故事自然注定会将你引向坐拥庞大后宫的未来。尽情享受这段不断展开的故事吧，希望你会喜欢。

[摘自[url=https://darklender-studios.itch.io/fantasy-school]itch.io[/url]]
